name: Tutorial — Your First Company
description: Learn the basics of running a company in Magnate. Follow the five steps and you'll ship your first product, run your first ad campaign, and grow a profitable business. Suggested for new players.

goals.description: Step 1 — Open Manage (in-game button). Go to the Build tab. Pick any city, choose Supermarket, and click Construct. Buildings cost cash but turn into revenue-generating assets on your balance sheet.

Step 2 — Before clicking Construct (or in the building's Inspect view), pick soft_drink as the first-slot product. Set a price around $1.80 and restock target around 500,000. Your store will auto-buy inventory from the world market each month.
Step 3 — Go back to the main HUD and click Play. The sim ticks one month per second. Let 3 months pass to see your store serve customers and rack up sales. Watch your cash and ledger entries grow.

Step 4 — Go to Manage → Campaigns. Start a TV ad campaign for soft_drink in your city at $50,000/month. Brand awareness builds over time and increases your market share — competitors without ads will lose customers to you.

Step 5 — Grow your company to $20M corporate value (cash + inventory + buildings). Try the Reports scene to see your accrual books, per-product margins, and goal progress. Tune prices, ad budgets, and restock targets via the Inspect button.
